register.title: Branches
register.subtitle: Every branch in the network, its lifecycle status and the people who lead it.
register.emptyBody: Branches you create appear here with their code and status.
register.caption: Branch register
register.readOnlyNotice: You can view branches. Only a Super Admin can create or change them.

create.title: Create a branch
create.intro: The code is assigned automatically. New branches start as Forming.
create.name: Branch name

detail.title: Branch
detail.openReports: {count, plural, =0 {No open reports} one {# open report} other {# open reports}}
detail.readOnlyNotice: You can view this branch. Only a Super Admin can change its details, status or leads.
detail.closedNotice: This branch is closed. Its records stay available, but nothing about it can change.

status.confirmCloseBody: {name} will become read-only for good. Collections and reports stay on record, but no new ones can be added and the branch cannot be reopened.
status.confirmPauseBody: {name} will stop accepting new collections until it is made active again.
status.noMoves: No further moves. A closed branch stays closed.

statusHelp.forming: Being set up. Collections can be logged while the team gets going.
statusHelp.active: Operating normally and accepting collections and weekly reports.
statusHelp.paused: Temporarily on hold. No new collections until it is active again.
statusHelp.closed: Permanently closed and read-only. History stays on record.

leads.title: Leads
leads.assignHint: Only active Branch Lead and HR Lead accounts are listed.
leads.moveWarning: A person leads one branch at a time. Assigning them here removes them from their current branch.

errors.invalid_transition: That move is not allowed from the current status. The page now shows the latest status.
errors.branch_has_open_reports: This branch still has open weekly reports. Approve or resolve them before closing it.
errors.branch_closed: This branch is closed and can no longer be changed.
errors.duplicate_branch_name: Another branch already uses this name. Choose a different one.
errors.invalid_user: This person cannot lead a branch. Choose an active Branch Lead or HR Lead.
errors.too_long: This is too long. Shorten it and try again.
errors.empty_patch: Change at least one field before saving.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
